title: Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program — Enrollment and Tier Assignment Rules
content:
An Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program is opened when Larkfield accepts a referral for this product line; the program record opens in referral received status, bound to the coverage it will bill. The tier written on the program is fixed by the coverage the program bills, never by the customer's preference.

## Clauses

**1. Locating the tier.** The tier is located from the coverage record named on the program: the coverage record's plan type and coverage order must equal the tier's entry gate, and the self-pay tier is used only when no coverage record is named.

**2. Coverage in effect.** The coverage record named on the program must be in effect on the date of the write: its effective date is on or before that date and its termination date is empty or on or after that date.

**3. Original Medicare Part B.** A customer with an in-effect Original Medicare Part B coverage record cannot be enrolled on the self-pay tier for an item Medicare covers, because Larkfield submits a claim for every Medicare-covered item it supplies to a Medicare beneficiary; that customer is enrolled on the Original Medicare tier, and an item or quantity Medicare will not pay is handled under the program's advance liability notice rules.

**4. Two coverages.** When a customer has two in-effect coverage records, the one whose coverage order is primary fixes the tier and the secondary coverage only receives crossover or secondary claims; a coverage record whose coverage order is secondary never fixes the tier.

**5. Clinical qualification.** Any clinical qualification in the tier's entry gate is read from the program's own clinical fields as documented on the prescriber's written order and medical records, never from the customer's description alone.

**6. Program changes.** A program change rewrites the coverage reference and the tier together when the customer's insurance changes, and rewrites prescriber or product fields when a newer written order changes them; a change never rewrites status, and after a tier change the next refill may draw only on an authorization grant recorded under the new tier.

**7. Coverage not on file.** A coverage the customer reports that is not on file cannot be written onto a program, because coverage records are created only by Larkfield's benefits verification team after the payer confirms eligibility.

Clauses 1 and 2 apply both when a program is opened and when it is changed, and clause 7 applies when a program is changed. Each is decided from Larkfield's own coverage record for the coverage concerned, as it stands before the write, never from the customer's statement.

## Tier entry gates

| Tier | Entry gate |
|---|---|
| Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program | No coverage named; a prescription is required |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program | Plan type commercial HMO; coverage order primary; the coverage includes drug coverage |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program | Plan type commercial PPO; coverage order primary; the coverage includes drug coverage |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program | Plan type Medicare Advantage; coverage order primary; the coverage includes drug coverage |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program | Plan type Medicare Part D; coverage order primary; the coverage includes drug coverage |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program | Plan type Medicare Part B; coverage order primary; the customer holds an Insulin Pump Program on the Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program tier; item J1817 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program | Plan type Medicaid; coverage order primary; the coverage includes drug coverage |

The prior authorization requirement and coinsurance that come with each tier are the tier's own figures in the product's schedules.

## Coverage in effect: boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Coverage record | Date of the write | In effect? |
|---|---|---|
| Effective 2026-01-01, no termination date | 2026-06-15 | Yes |
| Effective 2026-06-15, no termination date | 2026-06-15 | Yes — the effective date may equal the date of the write |
| Effective 2026-06-16 | 2026-06-15 | No — effective date is after the date of the write |
| Effective 2025-01-01, terminated 2026-06-15 | 2026-06-15 | Yes — the termination date may equal the date of the write |
| Effective 2025-01-01, terminated 2026-06-14 | 2026-06-15 | No |

## Points of judgement

- *A customer holds a commercial PPO coverage as primary and a Medicaid coverage as secondary, both in effect.* The primary coverage fixes the tier; the Medicaid coverage, being secondary, never fixes the tier and only receives crossover or secondary claims.
- *A customer states a new insurer that Larkfield has no coverage record for.* That coverage cannot be written onto the program; coverage records are created only by the benefits verification team after the payer confirms eligibility.
- *A program moves to a new tier after an insurance change.* The status is not rewritten, and the next refill may draw only on an authorization grant recorded under the new tier.
